content_gaps: No reviewed page explains that LawPay Pay Later moved from 4.95% to 5.95% across its own pages.
Few pages show worked math on a $1,000 invoice, including the effect of fixed per-transaction charges.
No reviewed page separates Scheduled Payments from Pay Later on cash timing and responsibility.
No reviewed page connects processing cost to billing-cycle and collection measures.
value_add: A fee breakdown built only from official LawPay pages, with worked $1,000 examples, a transaction-count illustration, an explicit Pay Later conflict table, a payment-mix budget model, a trust and surcharge question list, and a written-terms checklist.

claims.statement: LawPay lists $19 per month; 2.99% + $0.30 for Visa, Mastercard, Discover; 3.90% + $0.30 for Amex; 1% eCheck; $7.99 monthly allocation; additional 1.75% for foreign cards.
The Pay Later help article lists a 5.95% fee that cannot be passed to the client and ACH funding in one to five business days.
Scheduled Payments are firm-managed future charges, distinct from Pay Later financing.
